COMPLETE FIELDS IN SOURCE ORDER:
No extra input fields.
IMPLEMENTED ACTION WHITELIST:
WS-009 重新加载 / 刷新: Retry load or replace stale feed; guard: Owner session; control-specific guards described in permissionRules.

ALL IMPORTANT STATES (stateCoverage maps visible/shared-pattern/nonvisual rules; never depict incompatible alternatives together):
WS-009: Skeleton initial load
WS-009: Empty collection
WS-009: Source version changed banner disables old pagination
WS-009: Partial list remains visible on page error
WS-009: Load-more busy/end status
SOURCE NOTES:

RESPONSIVE Linked390/320 jobs handle compact field order/drawer/stacking and safe scrolling. 
FORBIDDEN:
Brand is DooKnow; ToDoo is an existing app and style reference only.
No invented fields, actions, role hierarchy, authentication gate, password sharing gate, automatic save guarantee or backend expansion.
No real secrets, share capabilities or private data: use fictional legal example content, example.invalid URLs, masked secret fields.
Never render API protocol metadata requestId/hash/cursor/expectedVersion as editable fields unless the actual source UI has that input.
No native OS/browser picker or print-dialog chrome.
No owner account/tree/file/share-management/upload/generate controls in a public guest or standalone export host.
No developer/source/API path or review-note text inside product UI.
All mockups and per-image/global functional reviews must pass before product development. Do not draw protocol metadata as form controls.
SELECTED COMPATIBLE VISIBLE STATE: Show one complete recent-notes collection with existing first-page items retained and a next-page load error. Do not show initial skeletons, empty message, stale/version banner or loading spinner simultaneously. This is the partial-list-error branch only; the remaining listed states remain separate contracts. Source header 我的笔记 / 最近 / 8 篇笔记 / 按最近修改排序; existing refresh icon enabled because loading=false, 新建笔记 enabled. Keep three fictional legal-example cards with source title, summary, parent folder, timestamp and source star/more affordances; these existing cards remain usable. Error block below cards reads 下一页加载失败，请重试 with source 重新加载 button enabled. Footer reads 已加载 3 / 8 篇; existing 加载更多笔记 button MUST be visibly disabled while error exists. No end-of-list claim, no extra field, no route/API details. Keep source owner navigation context with active 最近, contextual sidebar/search/new controls only as existing in source. Source caption must identify WS-009 / collection feedback / authenticated owner / partial list retained on page error.
FLAT STYLE CONTRACT: Style authority is actual ToDoo screenshot ONLY; source authority is actual DooKnow components. No ToDoo task/goal actions. Solid #ffffff main/header; #f7f8fa sidebar; #272b3a text; #657084 muted; #e6e9f1 borders; #4566c6 primary; #edf1ff selected. Thin crisp line icons, clean sans-serif Chinese, 8px radii, minimal shadow. No gradient, texture, grain, glow, bevel, simulated paper or illustration. Include source ID/title/authenticated owner/selected visible state in a thin external margin, never inside product UI. No browser chrome or device frame. No invented save, AI, sharing or collaboration UI.
